verdict.rationale: YYLO is a coding-agent orchestrator, so this story applies, but the evidence never documents agents generating tests or running them automatically to self-validate changes. The docs mention 'validation' boundaries and 'candidate checks', but the GitHub README says tests are 'explicit project checks outside merge' and that merge 'schedules no suites'. At most this is an adjacent, user-configured validation step, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent automatically generate and run tests to validate its own code changes before proposing them
